classification.difficultyReason: Angle sum, sine rule for a side, then SAS area; hint given and no ambiguous inverse-sine part.

content.prompt:
Calculate the area of this triangle to 1 d.p.

(Hint: Use sine rule and angle sum of a triangle)

answer.worked:
Let $\theta$ be the top angle and $x$ the side opposite the $52^\circ$ angle.
$$\begin{align*}
\theta&=180^\circ-52^\circ-71^\circ=57^\circ\\[8pt]
\frac{x}{\sin52^\circ}&=\frac{12.4}{\sin71^\circ}\\[8pt]
x&=\frac{12.4\sin52^\circ}{\sin71^\circ}\\[8pt]
A&=\frac12(12.4)\left(\frac{12.4\sin52^\circ}{\sin71^\circ}\right)\sin57^\circ\\[8pt]
A&\approx53.7\text{ cm}^2
\end{align*}$$
